title: NEB Class 11 Physics — Capacitor — 2024
subject: physics
source: NEB Grade 11 Model Questions / NEB Past Papers 2020-2024

questions.question: Define capacitance. Derive the capacitance of a parallel plate capacitor.
questions.solution:
**Capacitance** C = Q/V: charge stored per unit voltage. SI unit: **farad (F)**.

Two plates of area A, separation d, charge ±Q: field E = σ/ε₀ = Q/(Aε₀). Potential V = Ed = Qd/(Aε₀).

C = Q/V = **ε₀A/d**. With a dielectric of constant εᵣ filling the gap: C = εᵣε₀A/d.
questions.knowledgeNote: 1 F is enormous — real capacitors live in the pF–mF range, so NEB answers in μF/pF are a sanity check.

questions.question: A parallel plate air capacitor has plates of area 0.04 m² separated by 2 mm. Calculate its capacitance. (ε₀ = 8.85 × 10⁻¹² F/m)
questions.knowledgeNote: C ∝ A/d — doubling the plate area or halving the gap doubles the capacitance.

questions.question: Capacitors of 2 μF and 3 μF are connected (i) in series and (ii) in parallel. Find the equivalent capacitance in each case.
questions.solution:
(i) Series: 1/C = 1/2 + 1/3 = 5/6 → C = **1.2 μF** (series is always smaller than the smallest).

(ii) Parallel: C = 2 + 3 = **5 μF**.
questions.knowledgeNote: Capacitors combine oppositely to resistors: series shrinks, parallel adds — mixing them up is the standard trap.

questions.question: A 12 μF capacitor is charged to 100 V. How much energy is stored in it?
questions.knowledgeNote: U = ½CV² = Q²/2C = ½QV — pick the form matching the given pair (C,V), (C,Q), or (Q,V).

questions.question: What is a dielectric? Explain how inserting a dielectric slab increases the capacitance of a capacitor.
questions.solution:
A **dielectric** is an insulating material whose molecules polarise in an electric field.

The induced surface charges oppose the plate charges, weakening the internal field E. Since V = Ed falls while Q stays fixed, C = Q/V **rises by the dielectric constant εᵣ** (C = εᵣC₀).
questions.knowledgeNote: Battery connected (V fixed) vs isolated (Q fixed) give opposite energy answers — always check which is held constant.

questions.question: Write any four uses of capacitors.
questions.solution: (1) Smoothing/filtering ripples in power supplies. (2) Tuning radio circuits (with an inductor). (3) Storing the firing energy in camera flashes and defibrillators. (4) Power-factor correction in factories; (5) blocking DC while passing AC between amplifier stages.
questions.knowledgeNote: Every use exploits one property: capacitors store charge, block DC, and pass AC.
